about: Single source of the Azure resource library. settings holds the real keys that switch a resource on (variables.json, or an AIF_ input of the simple-mode bootstrap); a resource without a switch says in without_setting what provides it. The default of each setting is read from environment_setup/aifactory/variables.json when the page is built; on_when names the value that switches the resource on when that is not true, and switch names the setting that decides when it is not the first one. label is the name the architecture images use for the resource. template_service is the service name in code_templates.json.

not_listed.enablePersonas: Access model of the project team, not an Azure resource.
not_listed.enablePublicGenAIAccess: Networking mode, not an Azure resource.
not_listed.enablePublicAccessWithPerimeter: Networking mode, not an Azure resource.
not_listed.enableEncryptionAtHost: Option of the virtual machines and AKS nodes.
not_listed.enableDeleteForDisabledResources: Delete switch, explained on the home page.
